themes.name: Affordable housing and rentals
themes.rule: Proposals about creating, converting, subsidizing, upgrading, or making information available for affordable housing and rental homes belong here.

themes.name: Schools and youth learning
themes.rule: Proposals about school staffing, class conditions, student meals, tutoring, school facilities, or free arts instruction for children belong here.

themes.name: Healthcare and home care
themes.rule: Proposals about access to medical appointments, clinics, preventive screenings, mental-health treatment, or care for older residents belong here.

themes.name: Public transit and street safety
themes.rule: Proposals about bus fares, bus schedules or rider information, cycling infrastructure, or traffic safety measures belong here.

themes.name: Digital civic access
themes.rule: Proposals about putting city services or information online, helping residents use digital services, public internet access, or unified municipal contact channels belong here.

themes.name: Waste, energy, and pollution
themes.rule: Proposals about renewable energy, recycling, composting, reducing disposable plastics, or monitoring air pollution belong here.

themes.name: Parks and outdoor amenities
themes.rule: Proposals about playgrounds, dog areas, trees, parks, community gardens, or other outdoor neighborhood recreation spaces belong here.

themes.name: Culture and public gathering
themes.rule: Proposals about museums, public art, festivals, music events, or neighborhood library branches belong here.

themes.name: Local jobs and small business
themes.rule: Proposals about workforce retraining, local-hiring requirements, business licensing, small-business credit, or coworking space belong here.

themes.name: Public safety and emergency response
themes.rule: Proposals about emergency-service stations, street lighting, neighborhood policing, or surveillance at crime hotspots belong here.
